description: Default parse of an email is the body alone, as Tika gives it; the headers are metadata only, and the original Date string is not kept (Tika's RFC822Parser does not either). Guards ParseOptions.emailHeaders being opt-in (tikajs-5qkk).

input.text:
Date: Tue, 01 Oct 2024 12:34:56 -0500
From: sender@example.com
To: recipient@example.com
Subject: Example RFC 822 Email
Message-ID: <1@example.com>

This is an RFC 822 email message.

assertions.value: This is an RFC 822 email message.
